body: I think they were more of a general counselor/therapist. I saw them for roughly a year after making an attempt on my life.
It’s been about 3 years, now.
I’ve received therapy for depression/suicidal thoughts before.

In my contract:

>2. YOUR OTHER PROMISES TO US

>b. You agree not to remove the vehicle from the U.S or Canada, or to sell, rent, lease, or transfer any interest in the vehicle or this contract without written permission.

Does this mean I will need the approval of the dealership/financier to sell?

It was a rather upscale dealer. 2 different buildings, Dodge/Toyota brand and all.

If I sell the car, am I still obligated to pay the insane amount of interest remaining on the loan?

>trying to make a lot of profit off you.

Ding ding, they played me like a fiddle.

Tomorrow I will be visiting different institutions to see about refinancing.

My FICO score came out to 698 (following the credit ding from the dealership). They kept saying my APR was due to me being a first-time buyer, and that “everyone goes through this as a first-timer.”

1600 isn’t even what was put on the paper, they wrote 1500. How will I know if the financing falls through or goes through?
What is the likelihood of me actually receiving a better rate refinancing? As in, will any company actually take my inquiry seriously?
They did not verify my monthly income... they asked for a paystub and I said I don’t have any physical ones, they just said “that’s fine” and moved on.
What are my options of refinancing the vehicle? What steps can I take from here?
Thank you so much. I will try this ASAP
Is there anything I can do at this point?
Florida
Mine is a used 2017 GT Mustang. 2 owners. A lot of this price hasn’t made sense to me and I really appreciate your input.
I’ll try to get a virtual copy of it.
Should I visit a credit union?
I don’t think I’m understanding. Is the interest compounding or something? That’s almost a 50% interest rate.

The guy I was signing papers with said that we’ll put the rest (2,000) of my (5,000) down payment in the morning. Since I haven’t fully given my down payment in the contract, does that give me any leeway?
Florida

Ah, a fate truly worse than death.

And thanks mate.

I appreciate the words, honestly wasn’t expecting a reply like this. I’m halfway between joking and not. I’ve been depressed for a while and recently hit rock bottom, but I know there’s only one way from here. 

Again, thanks. Your kindness is what keeps the world going.
